GenKeyPairQuery.description: The settings of a key pair to generate. Every field is optional, an empty object generating a 2048 bits rsa key pair

algo.description: The algorithm of the key pair, as known by BouncyCastle: `rsa`, `ecdsa` (an elliptic curve key pair, its curve picked from the size), or another algorithm name such as `ec` or `dsa`. Defaults to `rsa`

size.description: The size of the key in bits, 2048 by default: 2048 or 4096 for an rsa key; 256, 384 or 521 for an `ecdsa` key (the curves secp256r1, secp384r1 and secp521r1, any other size giving secp256r1)

GenCsrQuery.description: The settings of a certificate (or of a certificate signing request) to generate with the pki of otoroshi: its key pair, its subject, its alternative names, its usages and its lifetime. Its key pair is described by `key`, or by `keyType` and `keySize`: a query that gives none of them is refused. The certificate is a server certificate (extended key usage `serverAuth`) unless `client` or `ca` says otherwise

hosts.description: The dns names written as subject alternative names of the certificate (ignored for a ca)

key.description: The key pair of the certificate. Required unless `keyType` and `keySize` are given, `{}` giving a 2048 bits rsa key pair

keyType.description: The algorithm of the key pair (`RSA`, `ECDSA`...), read lowercased when `key` is absent, `keySize` being then required too. Never written back

keySize.description: The size of the key in bits, read when `key` is absent, `keyType` being then required too. Never written back

name.description: The parts of the distinguished name of the subject (`CN`, `OU`, `O`, `L`, `ST`, `C`...), used when `subject` is absent

additionalProperties.description: The value of the part of the distinguished name

subject.description: The distinguished name of the subject of the certificate. When absent, it is built from `name`

client.description: Whether the certificate is a client certificate (extended key usages `clientAuth` and `serverAuth`). Defaults to false

ca.description: Whether the certificate is a certificate authority (basic constraint `CA:true`, key usages `keyCertSign` and `cRLSign`). Defaults to false

includeAIA.description: Whether to add the authority information access extension (the ocsp responder and the ca issuers urls of otoroshi) to a certificate signed by the root ca of otoroshi. Defaults to false, never written back

duration.description: How long the certificate is valid from now, in milliseconds. Defaults to 365 days

signatureAlg.description: The signature algorithm of the certificate, as known by BouncyCastle. Defaults to `SHA256WithRSAEncryption`, `SHA256withECDSA` being the one of an elliptic curve key pair

digestAlg.description: The digest algorithm of the signature. Defaults to `SHA-256`

GenCsrResponse.description: A certificate signing request generated by the pki of otoroshi, with the key pair it was generated for. Nothing is stored

csr.description: The certificate signing request, PEM encoded

publicKey.description: The public key of the certificate signing request, PEM encoded

privateKey.description: The private key of the certificate signing request, PEM encoded (PKCS#8)

SignCertResponse.description: A certificate signed by a certificate authority of otoroshi from a certificate signing request. Nothing is stored

csr.description: The certificate signing request the certificate was signed from, PEM encoded

ca.description: The certificate of the certificate authority that signed the certificate, PEM encoded

GenCertResponse.description: A certificate ordered from Let's Encrypt, with its private key and the certificate of the authority that issued it

serial.description: The serial number of the certificate. It can be greater than a 64 bits integer

csr.description: A certificate signing request built for the domain and the subject of the certificate, PEM encoded

key.description: The private key of the certificate, PEM encoded (PKCS#8)

ca.description: The certificate of the authority that issued the certificate, PEM encoded

query.description: The domain and the subject of the certificate, as a certificate query

certId.description: The id of the certificate entity otoroshi stored for the certificate

GeneratedCertificate.description: A certificate generated by the pki of otoroshi, as a certificate entity, with the id it was stored under

allOf.description: The id the certificate was stored under

certId.description: The id of the stored certificate entity, the same as its `id`. Absent when the certificate is not stored (`persist=false`)

LetsEncryptCertificateQuery.description: The domain of a certificate to order from Let's Encrypt

host.description: The domain of the certificate. It has to resolve to this otoroshi, Let's Encrypt validating the order with an http-01 challenge served by otoroshi

CertificateValidity.description: Whether a certificate can be loaded by otoroshi

valid.description: Whether the private key of the certificate can be read (with its password, if any) and its chain holds at least one certificate, the way otoroshi loads a certificate to serve tls. Neither its validity period nor its revocation are checked

CertificateExtension.description: An extension of an X509 certificate

oid.description: The object identifier of the extension, in dotted notation: `2.5.29.17` for the subject alternative names, `2.5.29.19` for the basic constraints, `2.5.29.15` for the key usages, `2.5.29.37` for the extended key usages...

value.description: The raw DER encoded value of the extension, its bytes read as an utf-8 string: the readable parts (a dns name) show through, the others are unreadable

CertificateData.description: What an X509 certificate holds: its subject, its issuer, its validity period, its serial number, its signature, its public key, its usages and its extensions

issuerDN.description: The distinguished name of the issuer of the certificate

notAfter.description: The end of the validity period of the certificate, a timestamp in milliseconds

notBefore.description: The start of the validity period of the certificate, a timestamp in milliseconds

serialNumber.description: The serial number of the certificate, in lowercase hexadecimal

serialNumberLng.description: The serial number of the certificate, as a number. It can be greater than a 64 bits integer

sigAlgName.description: The name of the signature algorithm of the certificate

sigAlgOID.description: The object identifier of the signature algorithm of the certificate

_signature.description: The signature of the certificate, base64 encoded

signature.description: The sha-256 digest of the signature of the certificate, as uppercase hexadecimal bytes separated by colons

subjectDN.description: The distinguished name of the subject of the certificate

domain.description: The main domain of the certificate: its first subject alternative name, or the common name of its subject, or its whole subject

rawDomain.description: The common name of the subject of the certificate, null when it has none

version.description: The version of the X509 format of the certificate

type.description: The type of the certificate, as named by the java certificate factory: always `X.509`

publicKey.description: The public key of the certificate, PEM encoded

selfSigned.description: Whether the certificate is self signed

constraints.description: The basic constraints of the certificate: -1 when it is not a certificate authority, otherwise the number of intermediate certificate authorities allowed under it (2147483647 when unlimited)

ca.description: Whether the certificate is a certificate authority

client.description: Whether the certificate can authenticate a client (extended key usage `clientAuth`)

subAltNames.description: The subject alternative names of the certificate

cExtensions.description: The extensions of the certificate marked critical, that a reader has to understand to accept the certificate (like the basic constraints or the key usages)

ncExtensions.description: The extensions of the certificate that are not marked critical (like the subject alternative names)
